## Layout

```
FaceGate/
├── README.md
├── requirements.txt
├── requirements-train.txt
├── docs/                     # This Quarto website
└── eye-tracking/
    ├── app/                  # Desktop GUI + pipeline
    ├── common/               # Shared library
    ├── webcam-capture/
    ├── camera-calibration/
    ├── face-recognition/     # Gallery + enroll / recognize CLIs
    ├── pupil-segmentation/
    ├── gaze-estimation/
    ├── performance-metrics/
    ├── docs/                 # Specs / slides (ODT, ODP)
    └── tests/
```

## Module map

| Module | Role | Entry points |
|--------|------|----------------|
| `app/` | Desktop GUI + unified pipeline | `launch.py`, `run_pipeline.py` |
| `face-recognition/` | Enroll & recognize | `enroll.py`, `recognize_live.py`, `enroll_image.py`, `recognize_image.py` |
| `webcam-capture/` | Webcam preview | `input-camera.py` |
| `camera-calibration/` | Intrinsics (chessboard) | `take_photo.py`, `calibration.py` |
| `pupil-segmentation/` | Eye / pupil localization | `run_demo.py` |
| `gaze-estimation/` | Gaze calibration & pointer | `run_calibration.py` |
| `performance-metrics/` | Session metrics / logs | pipeline `--enable-log` |
| `common/` | Reusable library | gallery, engine, camera_io, quality, … |

## Pipeline stages

When you run `python app/run_pipeline.py --recognize`:

1. **webcam-capture** — grab frame  
2. **camera-calibration** — optional undistortion  
3. **face-recognition** — detect (+ identify)  
4. **pupil-segmentation** — eye ROI + pupils  
5. **gaze-estimation** — pointer if a model exists  
6. **performance-metrics** — HUD / JSONL log  

## Shared library highlights

| Module | Responsibility |
|--------|----------------|
| `common/face_recognition.py` | Gallery + InsightFace matcher (`merge` enroll supported) |
| `common/engine.py` | Threaded realtime recognition |
| `common/camera_io.py` | Cross-platform webcam open / display helpers |
| `common/profiles.py` | `fast` / `balanced` / `accurate` |
| `common/quality.py` | Blur / size / frontal gates |
